title: My euro trip guide
text: I've now used Trales across Spain and Europe. There are stories all over and the guide doesn’t just list dates—it tells stories that made me care about the city in a whole new way. Great travel companion!
author: josefinea684

title: A surprising emotional connection to the city
text: I'm so glad I gave it a try. It's affordable, super easy to use, and incredibly informative. I explored parts of the city I wouldn’t have seen otherwise and felt like I got a much deeper understanding of Seville's culture and history.
author: 612alexander_
